text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky managed to achieve wonderful results in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, we made it through those
truly precious "first three years."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—as for Seiun Sky...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Zzz...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Mnh-mnh...
I can't run anymore~...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Wait, Sky-san!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you supposed to be
training with us today?!
Wake up already!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: S K Y - S A N !

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
S-Sei-chan!
Wake up, hurry~!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Mnh... I can't hear youuu...
Sei-chan isn't gonna do anything today-deeesu...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my~.
You're very obviously playing possum, aren't you~?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Waaah!
Grass has turned into a demon, deee-su!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
S-Sky-san's Trainer!
Don't just stand there staring, do something about this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, we can't just let Seiun Sky
keep slacking off like this, so...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's that—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: One more bid.
choice_data_list: Tackles, extra feed, borrow as much as you want!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm down!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Aw man, can't help getting lured in when it's you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: She woke up without any fuss...?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
W-What is with you two...?
Are your mind games always like this?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Mind games? Perish the thought!
It's just a little bit of fun~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph, I see.
So it's just playtime between an unprecedented trickster
and her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha~.
Calling it 'once in a generation' is giving me way too much credit, though.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's no fun just hooking fish and getting hooked
the usual way, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "I just want to enjoy everything, that's all. Right, Trainer?♪"
